claims.text: The latest stable release of Pulumi (pulumi/pulumi) is stated inconsistently on the page: v3.261.0 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table (L134) versus v3.263.0 (2026-09-16) in the license table and Pulumi section, as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable release of Terraform is v1.16.1 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table but v1.16.3 (2026-09-16) in the license table and Terraform section, as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable release of AWS CDK is v2.268.0 (2026-09-02) in the at-a-glance table but v2.270.0 (2026-09-17) in the license table and CDK section, as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable release of Azure Bicep is v0.47.16 (2026-09-08) in the license table and Bicep section, whereas the at-a-glance table (L139) was left at v0.46.1 (2026-07-30).
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable Crossplane release is v2.4.1 (2026-09-15) in the license table and Crossplane section, whereas the at-a-glance table (L142) lists v2.4.0 (2026-08-20).
The latest stable OpenTofu release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19, as of 2026-09-21.
Version and release-date figures in the tables were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.

By GitHub stars (measured 2026-09-21), Kubernetes has roughly 127,900 stars, Terraform roughly 49,700, OpenTofu roughly 30,200, Pulumi roughly 25,700, AWS CDK roughly 12,900, and Crossplane roughly 12,100; Terraform is the most-starred among dedicated IaC tools.

Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure management, respectively; Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption.
Env zero is the new name for env0 (formerly env0).
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
Env zero prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026, with the service fully turned down on June 30, 2027 (the previous text said December 31, 2025).
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits included and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month with 400 credits included and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise pricing is custom and contract-based.

HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier; Terraform Enterprise is self-hosted with custom pricing.
Pricing figures reflect published pricing as of September 2026 (checked 2026-09-21).
